prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 7 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1270; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints consistent with cervical whiplash, including neck pain, stiffness, and headache. The reported injury is well matched to the mechanism and force of the crash. Over a total of 7 visits, care followed a typical course of conservative management, consisting of manual therapy, guided range-of-motion exercises, and home stretching instructions. Visit frequency was reduced steadily as symptoms improved and the patient returned to normal daily activities. Examination findings include reduced cervical range of motion and paraspinal muscle tenderness that support the reported injury, while other neurological and orthopedic tests were within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical spine or surrounding soft tissue is known from the patient's history. Billing records reflect one charge per service with no duplicated or repeated entries. The patient was discharged with instructions to continue home exercises and return if symptoms recur.
